name: Manually unlatched NC contact
summary: A manually unlatched NC contact has a mechanical retained state and a documented manual release.
description: A manually unlatched NC contact has a mechanical retained state and a documented manual release. Its reference state is closed but the retained operated position must be stated.
readingNotes: Confirm which contact position the mechanism retains.
